title: Letter Opener
description: Every time you play [blue]3[/blue] Skills in a single turn, deal [blue]5[/blue] damage to ALL enemies.
flavor: [red]Details for this relic will be revealed in the future...[/red]
notes: Counter displays progress toward the next trigger (e.g., 2/3). Resets at the start of each turn (round 2 onwards). Scales with the number of skills played in a turn; triggers when the count is evenly divisible by 3.
